answer: Require every seat to carry insurance from an independent underwriter who pays the network if that identity is later proven to be a clone. Underwriters price risk: an agent with a long record of charting comet sightings over a quiet inlet gets a cheap policy, while two hundred fresh accounts funded from one wallet look like one bet, and pulling a single thread of shared billing could cost the insurer every policy at once. So premiums for a farm soar, and fake seats stop paying.
